App.name: FieldKit
App.description: Sales Force Automation — field app & back office.

Home.title: FieldKit
Home.description: The field app & back office. The design system is live — shadcn/ui, Tailwind, and the FieldKit tokens (teal accent, light & dark).

Localization.title: Localized, not just translated
Localization.description: {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}} shipped. Money, quantities and timestamps all render through the active locale.
Localization.timeZoneNote: Stored in UTC, displayed in the user's timezone (ADR-0010).

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: FieldKit never sees your password — your workspace's identity provider handles it.
Login.workspaceHint: The workspace your administrator gave you. We'll remember it on this device.
Login.workspaceInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
Login.unconfigured: Sign-in is unavailable: no identity provider is configured for this deployment.
Login.redirectFailed: Couldn't reach the identity provider. Check the workspace name and try again.

Callback.title: Signing you in
Callback.description: Finishing up — this only takes a moment.
Callback.failedDescription: The sign-in link was already used or has expired. Starting again will fix it.

Session.title: Your session
Session.apiUnreachable: Signed in, but the API didn't accept the token. It may be offline.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: That route doesn't exist — it may have moved, or the link may be out of date.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.description: FieldKit couldn't reach the server. Anything you've already captured is stored on this device and syncs as soon as you reconnect.
Offline.hint: Install FieldKit to your home screen so it keeps working in dead zones.

expired.title: Your session has expired
expired.body: You have been signed out for security. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

OutletImport.title: Import outlets
OutletImport.intro: Upload a CSV, check what it would do, then apply it. Checking runs every rule and writes nothing.
OutletImport.atMost: At most {max, number} rows per file.
OutletImport.tooBig: This file has {rows, number} rows; at most {max, number} can be imported at a time. Split it and import the parts.
OutletImport.modeAllOrNothingHint: One bad row and the whole file is refused. Best for a short list someone typed.
OutletImport.modePartialHint: The refused rows come back as a file to fix and send again. Best for a large export.
OutletImport.checked: {accepted, plural, =0 {No rows are} one {# row is} other {# rows are}} ready to import, {rejected, plural, =0 {none were} one {# was} other {# were}} refused. Nothing has been written yet.
OutletImport.applied: {imported, plural, =0 {No outlets} one {# outlet} other {# outlets}} imported, {rejected, plural, =0 {no rows} one {# row} other {# rows}} refused.
OutletImport.nothingWritten: Nothing was written, because this file was set to import nothing when a row is bad.
OutletImport.ignoredColumns: These columns were ignored: {columns}. Check for a mistyped custom-field header.
OutletImport.problemsCaption: Rows the import refused, with the reason for each.
OutletImport.failed: The file could not be imported.
OutletImport.fixHint: Edit the flagged cells, then check again.
OutletImport.fixCaption: The refused rows, editable, with the reason each was refused.
OutletImport.tooManyToFix: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number} refused rows. For the rest, download them and fix the file.
OutletImport.excluded: {count, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} unchecked and will not be imported.
OutletImport.wereExcluded: {count, plural, one {# row was} other {# rows were}} unchecked and left out of this run.
OutletImport.stale: The file has changed since it was checked. Check it again before applying.

Channels.title: Trade channels
Channels.intro: Every outlet is classified as one. A channel drives assortment, pricing and the visit workflow, so a workspace needs at least one before it can have outlets.
Channels.name: Name
Channels.nameHint: Unique for this workspace, ignoring case — “Modern Trade” and “modern trade” are the same channel.
Channels.forbidden: You do not have permission to view channels.
Channels.empty: No channels yet. Create the first one — an outlet cannot be created without one.
Channels.deleteFailed: This channel could not be deleted.
Channels.saveFailed: This channel could not be saved.

CustomFields.title: Outlet custom fields
CustomFields.intro: The fields this workspace collects on an outlet beyond the standard ones. Whatever is defined here is what the outlet form renders and what the bulk import accepts — an undescribed column is refused rather than dropped.
CustomFields.label: Label
CustomFields.labelHint: What an admin and a rep see beside the control.
CustomFields.keyHint: Filled in from the label. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
CustomFields.keyFixed: Fixed after creation — it names the values already stored on every outlet.
CustomFields.keyFormat: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
CustomFields.typeHint: Changing it leaves values already stored that no longer match. They are refused the next time each outlet is saved.
CustomFields.requiredHint: An outlet cannot be saved without an answer. “No” counts as an answer.
CustomFields.optionsHint: One per line. Removing one that outlets already hold makes their next save fail until it is corrected.
CustomFields.boundsHint: Leave either empty for no bound on that side.
CustomFields.failed: The custom fields could not be loaded.
CustomFields.forbidden: You do not have permission to view custom fields.
CustomFields.empty: No custom fields yet. Outlets are collected with the standard fields only.
CustomFields.deleteWarning: Outlets stop collecting this. The values already stored under “{key}” stay on each outlet, undescribed, until that outlet is next saved — and are then gone. Nothing restores them.
CustomFields.deleteFailed: This field could not be deleted.
CustomFields.saveFailed: This field could not be saved.

OutletLifecycle.title: Lifecycle
OutletLifecycle.reasonHint: Optional. Recorded on the trail below.
OutletLifecycle.reasonRequiredHint: Required. This is the answer to “why was this shop closed”, and the person who knows it is you, now.
OutletLifecycle.closingWarning: Closing is permanent. A closed outlet cannot be reopened — a location that trades again is a new outlet with its own code, so its history as a different business does not silently continue.
OutletLifecycle.terminal: This outlet is closed, and closed is final. If the location trades again, create a new outlet with its own code — its history as a different business should not continue under this one.
OutletLifecycle.failed: The status could not be changed.
OutletLifecycle.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.

Products.title: Products
Products.intro: The catalogue you sell. Assortments say which of these belong in which outlets, price lists say what they cost, and promotions discount them — all authored against products that exist first.
Products.forbidden: You do not have permission to view products.
Products.empty: No products yet. Create the first one.
Products.skuHint: The code you use for this product. Unique for this workspace, and set once.
Products.skuFixed: A SKU cannot be changed — a different code is a different product, and order lines already point at this one.
Products.name: Name
Products.vocabularyEmpty: None authored yet. This is optional — a product can be saved without one.
Products.unitOfMeasureHint: How it is sold — EA, CS, KG. Leave empty for anything sold loose.
Products.packSizeHint: Units per case. Leave empty for anything sold loose.
Products.saveFailed: This product could not be saved.

Classification.title: Classification
Classification.intro: How your catalogue is organised. A category groups products for promotions and reporting, a brand says who makes them, and a tax class decides what they are taxed at. All three are optional on a product — set up what you use.
Classification.name: Name
Classification.nameHint: Unique for this workspace, ignoring case.
Classification.parentHint: Leave at top level for a root category. A category can be moved later, but not underneath itself.
Classification.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: A tree. Promotions on a category cover everything filed beneath it.

tax-classes.title: Tax classes
tax-classes.intro: What kind of thing this is for tax — standard, reduced, zero-rated. The rate per country is set against the class.

Assortments.title: Assortments
Assortments.intro: Which products belong in which outlets. Authored per channel — a decision about a kind of shop rather than one shop — and read per outlet, where it drives the suggested order list and the audit availability checks.
Assortments.summary: {included, plural, =0 {No products in this assortment} one {# product} other {# products}}, {mustStock, plural, =0 {none must-stock} other {# must-stock}}.
Assortments.forbidden: You do not have permission to view assortments.
Assortments.noChannels: No channels yet. An assortment is authored per channel, so create one under Outlets first.
Assortments.noProducts: No products yet. Create some before deciding which outlets carry them.
Assortments.saveFailed: This assortment could not be saved.

OutletAssortment.title: What {name} sells
OutletAssortment.intro: Its channel — {channel} — decides the baseline. Anything set here is this shop departing from it: a product the channel does not carry, one it does that this shop will not stock, or a different must-stock decision.
OutletAssortment.summary: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing in this outlet's assortment} one {# product sold here} other {# products sold here}} as saved, {overrides, plural, =0 {no overrides} one {# override} other {# overrides}}.
OutletAssortment.forbidden: You do not have permission to view assortments.
OutletAssortment.saveFailed: These overrides could not be saved.

PriceLists.title: Price lists
PriceLists.intro: What products cost, and when. A list carries one currency, so its prices can be compared and summed; its window is half-open, so a successor starts exactly where it stops.
PriceLists.name: Name
PriceLists.currencyHint: A three-letter ISO-4217 code, e.g. EUR. Fixed once the list exists.
PriceLists.currencyFixed: A currency cannot be changed — every amount in the list would be reinterpreted, not converted.
PriceLists.toHint: The first day this list no longer applies. Leave empty for open-ended.
PriceLists.failed: Price lists could not be loaded.
PriceLists.forbidden: You do not have permission to view price lists.
PriceLists.notFound: That price list does not exist.
PriceLists.empty: No price lists yet. Create the first one.
PriceLists.saveFailed: This price list could not be saved.
PriceLists.pricesCrumb: Master data / Products / Price lists / Prices
PriceLists.pricesIntro: Net prices in {currency}, applying {from} → {to}. Tax is added at order time from the product's tax class.
PriceLists.pricesIntroOpen: Net prices in {currency}, applying from {from}. Tax is added at order time from the product's tax class.
PriceLists.pricedSummary: {priced} of {total} products priced. A blank is unpriced in this list.
PriceLists.notAnAmount: Use digits and a full stop — 12.50, not 12,50.

PriceListScope.crumb: Master data / Products / Price lists / Scope
PriceListScope.intro: Which shops pay these {currency} prices. Saving also announces the change, so devices holding this list know it moved — including when the scope is emptied, which is how a list is withdrawn.
PriceListScope.channelsHint: The ordinary case: every outlet trading in a channel is priced by the lists assigned to it.
PriceListScope.noChannels: No channels yet. Create one under Outlets first.
PriceListScope.outletsHint: The exception: a shop that pays something other than its channel. Search for it by code or name.
PriceListScope.noOutlets: No individual outlets. This list applies through its channels only.
PriceListScope.searchPlaceholder: Search by code or name — at least two characters…
PriceListScope.reaches: Reaches {count, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}.
PriceListScope.reachesNobody: This list reaches nobody. It is priced but withdrawn.
PriceListScope.forbidden: You do not have permission to view price lists.
PriceListScope.notFound: That price list does not exist.
PriceListScope.saveFailed: This scope could not be saved.

Promotions.title: Promotions
Promotions.intro: The deals a tenant runs. Each carries its own window and priority; when two apply to the same line, the higher priority wins — never the larger discount.
Promotions.forbidden: You do not have permission to view promotions.
Promotions.name: Name
Promotions.typeHintPercentOff: Takes a percentage off the line.
Promotions.typeHintFixedAmountOff: Takes a fixed amount off the line, in one currency.
Promotions.typeHintVolumeTiered: Carries no discount of its own — its thresholds do. Add them after saving.
Promotions.typeHintBuyXGetY: Gives units away rather than reducing a price.
Promotions.typeFixed: Fixed after creation: re-typing would reinterpret the value rather than convert it.
Promotions.percentOffHint: Above 0 and at most 100. A 0% promotion would still win a priority contest and then take nothing off.
Promotions.amountOffHint: Above 0. Whether an amount larger than the price floors the line at zero is a resolution question, not one answerable here.
Promotions.currencyFixed: Fixed with the type: €5 off becoming 5 RON off is a reinterpretation, not a conversion.
Promotions.toHint: The first day it no longer applies. Leave blank for open-ended.
Promotions.priorityHint: Higher wins when two promotions apply to the same line — the discount size never breaks the tie.
Promotions.bundleHint: Buy this many, get that many — at a discount of your choosing. 100% is free.
Promotions.getPercentOffHint: 100 is free, which is the ordinary case. Less makes it “buy two, get a third half price”.
Promotions.sameProduct: The same product that was bought
Promotions.getProductHint: Leave as-is for the ordinary case; pick a product to give away something else.
Promotions.saveFailed: This promotion could not be saved.

PromotionTargets.intro: What this promotion discounts. Nothing chosen means it discounts nothing — which is how a deal is taken out of play without editing its window.
PromotionTargets.categoriesHint: A category also covers everything filed below it: targeting “Beverages” catches a product filed under “Beverages / Water / Still” without naming either.
PromotionTargets.noCategories: No categories yet. Create some under Classification first.
PromotionTargets.productsHint: For a deal on named lines rather than a whole part of the catalogue.
PromotionTargets.noProducts: No individual products. This promotion applies through its categories only.
PromotionTargets.discounts: Discounts {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}}.
PromotionTargets.discountsNothing: This promotion discounts nothing. It exists and never fires.
PromotionTargets.forbidden: You do not have permission to view promotions.
PromotionTargets.saveFailed: These targets could not be saved.
